claim: runtime-core crates do not parse YAML, parse or route JSON, serve HTTP, or accept text command protocols
expected_evidence: moon ci records dependency-boundary or banned-token gate PASS for runtime-core YAML/JSON/HTTP/text protocol exclusions

claim: strict accepted-run acknowledgement occurs only after source, accepted artifact, run header, RunAccepted event, and required indexes are durable, or the operation fails before acknowledgement
expected_evidence: TLC reports no violations of NoAckWithoutDurableAcceptedRecords and EventuallyAckOrFailBeforeAck under configured bounds
fairness: weak fairness on PersistBatch, AckAccepted, and FailBeforeAck when enabled
refinement: Rust strict admission records refine PersistBatch/AckAccepted by artifact digest, run id, and durability result

claim: admitted runs preserve monotonic journal order and move only through valid running, suspended, cancelled, finished, or failed lifecycle states
expected_evidence: TLC reports no violations of SeqMonotonic, ValidLifecycleTransition, or deadlock-freedom constraints
fairness: weak fairness on enabled internal Step, AppendJournal, and terminal actions; external action completion is not fair
refinement: Runtime journal events and EngineSignal outcomes refine TLA+ lifecycle actions by run id, step, sequence, and terminal state

claim: recovery and replay never reparse YAML and either hydrate from durable snapshot/journal evidence or fail closed on corrupt, incomplete, mismatched, or divergent records
expected_evidence: TLC reports NoRuntimeYaml and FailClosedRecovery invariants hold and RecoveryEventuallyHydratesOrFailsClosed is satisfied
fairness: weak fairness on enabled HydrateFromDurableRecords, DetectMismatch, and FailClosedRecovery actions
refinement: Storage recovery reports refine TLA+ recovery outcomes by run id, artifact digest, sequence, and typed recovery error

claim: capability lifecycle rejects missing, excessive, mismatched, or legacy-bypass grants before strict accepted artifact admission

fairness: weak fairness on VerifyGate and Admit/Reject when enabled
refinement: Verifier/runtime capability certificate and denial diagnostics refine TLA+ gate and admission states

claim: typed direct API and binary IPC ingress either enqueue within bounded capacity or return typed backpressure/invalid-protocol/operator diagnostics without loose YAML, JSON, HTTP, text-command, blocking, or unbounded-buffer bypass

finite command kinds: direct, ipc, yaml, json, http, text
finite diagnostics: accepted, backpressure, invalid_frame, unsupported_protocol, artifact_not_accepted
refinement: Runtime direct API calls and binary IPC frames refine SubmitDirect/SubmitIpc by command kind, artifact digest, queue capacity, and diagnostic class; CLI/operator output refines EmitTypedDiagnostic without becoming a text runtime protocol
